jobs.description:
Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

At Inetum Belgium, we offer more than just a job; we provide an inspiring environment and opportunities for growth and development. We strive to create a workplace where you can harness your talents, contribute to challenging projects, and be part of a leading IT consultancy group.

Job Description

Forget about conventional communication styles, the main language we speak is Java. So, If you are looking to upgrade your skills and working on exciting and challenging projects; just scroll down your mouse and learn how you can become the next Java developer Expert Inetum-Belgium is searching for.

As Java developer it will be expected of you:

 
• To share and upgrade your skills through multiple projects ranging from new applications & functionalities developments to complex cross-projects developments. Including elaboration and contribution to maintenance standards.
 
• To share you expertise and exchange about projects status and issues during the Scrum meetings.
 
• To help identify and bring your contribution to key improvements elements of development projects.
 
• To take the lead on the quality of the delivery by playing a proactive role in the testing phases at all the necessary steps of the development.
 
• To ensure the delivery of well designed, testable and efficient code
 
• To coach and help junior profiles on some matters (if you feel comfortable)

Discover your future with inetum belgium

 
• Make a Difference with a Meaningful Career: step into a role where your work truly matters. At Inetum Belgium, you'll have the chance to impact lives and drive meaningful change every day.
 
• Grow and Evolve Professionally: embrace a culture of continuous learning and development. We offer a range of training opportunities designed to help you expand your skills and advance your career.
 
• Unlock Relevant Career Opportunities: pursue the career path you've always dreamed of with tailored opportunities and the IT expertise you need to succeed.
 
• Achieve Work-Life Balance: we value your well-being. Enjoy flexible working hours, the convenience of satellite offices, the comfort of home working, and an informal, no-nonsense environment.
 
• Enjoy Generous Annual Leave: life is more than just work. Take advantage of 32 days of annual leave to relax and recharge.
 
• Travel in Comfort: forget the hassle of commuting. We provide a company car and a national fuel/charging card to keep you on the move. Prefer a different option? You can choose a mobility allowance instead

jobs.occupation: Order picker in day shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

jobs.occupation: Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering Data Centres
jobs.description:
As a Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, you will join an international engineering and consultancy firm specialising in the design and delivery of complex technical projects.

Within this position, the focus is on Mission Critical Facilities and data centres. These are technically demanding buildings where systems such as electrical power supply, cooling, redundancy, safety and operational continuity need to be closely integrated.

You will become part of a Belgian engineering team that is being further developed around data centre projects. From Belgium, you will work closely with international engineering teams on projects for both national and international clients.

You will work in a multidisciplinary environment where different technical areas of expertise come together to design and deliver complex projects.

Jobomschrijving

As a Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, you coordinate the entire engineering and design process. You monitor the technical scope, planning and engineering budget, ensuring that the different disciplines work together towards one integrated design.

• Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams within complex data centre projects

• Manage the technical scope, engineering budget and associated contract documentation

• Prepare and monitor the engineering schedule and allocate tasks within the team

• Coordinate the different technical disciplines and ensure alignment between their designs

• Coordinate collaboration between Belgian and international engineering teams

• Work closely with external consultants, contractors and other technical partners

• Review technical design decisions and challenge or adjust them where necessary

• Manage design changes and assess their impact on the overall project

• Translate complex client requirements into technically feasible solutions

• Present and discuss technical concepts with clients and project teams

• Remain involved during the execution phase and act as a technical point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders

For the position of Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, we are looking for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with excellent coordination skills. Experience within data centres is an advantage, but experience with industrial buildings or other technically complex building projects can also be a strong match.

• You hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline

• You have at least 5 years of experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects

• You have experience leading and coordinating engineers and other technical stakeholders

• You are familiar with complex technical building installations and multidisciplinary engineering

• Experience with data centres, industrial buildings or other complex built environments is a strong advantage

• You are familiar with digital engineering processes, 3D design and BIM environments

• You have a good understanding of relevant standards, regulations and working methods within engineering and construction

• You communicate effectively with engineers, consultants, contractors and clients

• English knowledge is a must, Dutch and French are a plus

Relevant experience is essential for this position. We are specifically looking for candidates who have previously worked in a similar role, coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects within data centres, industrial buildings or other technically complex environments.

If you do not have relevant experience in a comparable position or project environment, we kindly ask you not to apply for this vacancy.

For a leading manufacturer in the machine building industry in the region, we are looking for a dedicated Senior Electrical Engineer.

In this key engineering role, you will act as the technical owner for the complete electrical hardware design, ensuring every machine meets the highest quality and safety standards!

As Senior Electrical Engineer, you will take full ownership of the electrical engineering lifecycle:

• Concept & Project Planning: Participate in multidisciplinary project design meetings with mechanical and software engineers from the concept phase onwards, creating realistic project schedules and milestones.
• Electrical Design (EPLAN P8 & ProPanel): Translate draft electrical descriptions and specifications into clear, detailed hardware guidelines. Design and adapt electrical schematics in EPLAN P8 and create 3D panel/enclosure layouts in EPLAN ProPanel.
• Standards & Compliance: Ensure all designs strictly comply with European directives and international regulations (e.g., EN 60204, Machinery Directive, EMC, LVD).
• ERP & Production Follow-Up: Create and update ERP work orders for customer-specific projects and master BOMs for standard machinery. Closely monitor electrical assembly during the build phase in the workshop.
• Standardization & Mentorship: Develop, maintain, and continuously improve electrical design guidelines and best practices. Review schematics with colleagues, offer technical guidance, and actively drive departmental standardization initiatives.Profiel
• Education & Experience: You hold a Master’s degree in Industrial Sciences (Electromechanics / Electrotechnics) or possess equivalent experience. You have at least 5 years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably within the machine building sector.
• Software & Standards: Strong proficiency in EPLAN P8 is required (hands-on experience with EPLAN ProPanel is a major plus). Solid working knowledge of European electrical safety standards (familiarity with UL standards for the North American market is an asset).
• Key Strengths: You possess an analytical mindset, excellent problem-solving skills, and a structured way of working.
• Languages & Communication: Excellent communication skills in both English and Dutch, with a collaborative team spirit suited for an international environment.Wat je van ons krijgt
• Company Mobility: A representative company car with fuel card (also available for personal use).
• Attractive Salary Package: A highly competitive gross monthly salary tailored to your seniority and technical expertise, complemented by an extensive benefits package (meal vouchers, group insurance, healthcare coverage, and net allowances). 
• Impact & Ownership: A technical role offering high autonomy, allowing you to directly shape product designs and drive standardization.
• International Environment: A challenging, collaborative, and growth-oriented working culture with ample opportunities for professional development.

Jobomschrijving

Our customer is a leading international company active in the development, production, and distribution of high-quality products for the dental industry. They are looking for a Transport Officer. 

As a Transport Officer, you will be responsible for organizing and monitoring transport activities to ensure timely, cost-effective, and high-quality deliveries

Your Responsibilities

• Coordinate with transport partners to ensure timely collections and provide all required shipping documentation (pick-up lists, invoices, etc.).
• Communicate delivery schedules and transport documentation to customers and internal stakeholders.
• Collaborate with various departments and external partners to resolve delivery issues and transport-related complaints.

• Accept small incoming shipments and coordinate their internal distribution on site.
• Provide administrative support to the Logistics Transport Supervisor.
• Continuously identify opportunities to optimize transport efficiency and reduce shipping costs.

Your Profile

• Strong experience and knowledge in transport and logistics operations.
• Proven experience with the SAP transport module.
• Knowledge of customs regulations is an asset.
• Familiarity with dangerous goods regulations (IATA and ADR).
• Excellent command of Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a plus.
• Advanced user of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
• Willing to work a fixed schedule of 08:00 to 16:30.
• Strong communication and organizational skills.
• Positive, hands-on, and proactive mindset.

Company Activities:

Our client is known for its open and jovial atmosphere, characterized by a genuine worker culture and a sense of humor. The facility, located in a bustling logistics hub, includes warehouses that can experience temperature fluctuations when trucks are docked. They pride themselves on fostering a team-oriented environment where every member contributes to collective success.

Jobomschrijving

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic team at Site Zeebrugge? Our client is currently seeking Reachtruck Operators who will play a critical role in their logistics operations. As a Reachtruck Operator, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth movement and storage of goods within the facility.

Key Responsibilities:

Our client is looking for candidates who are either experienced Reachtruck Operators or possess a valid reachtruck certificate. You will have the opportunity to earn an internal certificate upon completing their training program. Language proficiency in Dutch, English, or French is required to ensure smooth communication within their multicultural team.
